player_prompt.intro:
Uri umukinnyi {player_id} ukina mchezo wa Pig Dice.

Amategeko:
- Ku gihe cawe, urashobora gukora '[roll]' cyangwa '[hold]'
- Gukunja 2-6: Ongeza kuri turn total yawe
- Gukunja 1: Uragura turn total yawe, ukarangiza igihe cawe
- Guhitimisha: Ongeza turn total yawe kuri alama zawe, ukarangiza igihe cawe
- Wa mbere ugeze kuri {winning_score} alama akatsinda

Igihe cawe, uzabona alama z'ubu na turn total.
Sobanura na '[roll]' kugukunja cyangwa '[hold]' kubika alama zawe.

actions.player_hold: Umukinnyi {player_id} araharanira kubika na kubasha {turn_total} pointi.

board.current_total_scores: Ibiharuro vy'ubu: {scores} Igitigiri canyu muri iki gihe ni {turn_total}.

outcome.winner_by_turn_limit: Umukinnyi {winner_id} yatsinze kubera kuba ufite alama kirekire mu muda wa turn ({scores})
outcome.winner_by_score: Umukinnyi {winner_id} yatsinze kubera kuzamura alama ya {winning_score}!
